versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00178 The Rte_GetMirror API shall be executed in the EcucPartition referenced by NvMBlockDescriptor . NvMBlockEcucPartitionRef .

The Rte_GetMirror API shall be executed in the EcucParti- tion referenced by the associated NvBlockDescriptor 's NvMBlockEcucParti- tionRef parameter. If this parameter does not exist, the Rte_GetMirror API shall be executed in the EcucPartition referenced by the ECUC parameter EcucDe- faultBswPartition .
